approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would stop the Commonwealth government and its agencies from funding coal-fired power stations.
It would ban spending on building, buying, refurbishing or helping transfer ownership of such stations.
The bill would allow financial support for worker transition assistance or managing a station's closure.
The bill prohibits Commonwealth funding for coal-fired power station construction, purchase, refurbishment or ownership transfer.
The bill permits financial support for transition assistance to affected workers or managing station closure.
The bill binds the Crown in all its capacities.
The Commonwealth government and its agencies, and owners or operators of coal-fired power stations.
